trap-superlative.evidence: CONVENTION MISLABEL - the block declares convention D and prints convention-C numbers. It states "with z = q^3/(q^2+1) (**convention D**)" and then asserts, unqualified, "the denominator factors as q^{10}(q+1)^3" and "tr_M(sigma_1^7 sigma_2^4)(q_0) approx 1.63315" and "rho_p^CODATA approx 1124.3". I re-derived the whole closed form in sympy from the block's own recurrence (a_0=0, b_0=1, a_{k+1}=h a_k + b_k, b_{k+1}=a_k, h=q-q^{-1}), evaluating tr = a_7 a_4 z^2 + (a_7 b_4 + b_7 a_4) z + b_7 b_4 at q_0 = 1.1099785827513808 under both conventions: convention C (z = sqrt(q)/(q+1)) gives 1.63315337744905357 and rho_p = 1124.2973; convention D (z = q^3/(q^2+1)) gives 1.88431946725497488 and rho_p = 974.437. The printed numbers are the C values, off from D by 15.38%. The denominator confirms it independently: in v = sqrt(q) the exact denominators are v^16(v^2+1) = q^8(q+1) under C and v^14(v^4+1)^2 = q^7(q^2+1)^2 under D. A (q+1) power is a convention-C signature that D cannot produce - D must carry (q^2+1), one factor per Markov peel - so the printed "q^{10}(q+1)^3" fails the convention-D denominator test on its own terms (and matches neither exact denominator, so the q^{10} and the cube are separately unexplained).
